holes.question: Which exact deterministic bytes constitute the private qualified Rune packet, and which request, canonical source, typed IR, Smith, rustc and projection identities must it bind?
How is one pre-admitted Vellum workspace document selected and re-observed without granting membership, locator, filesystem or sibling-document authority?
Which exact packet digest, target identity, current target revision and durable operation identity must the accountable human approval bind before any edit is sent?
How does an unknown Vellum workspace-edit outcome fence persistence and expose exact recovery without retrying or assuming that the target changed?
How are accepted, refused and unknown durable-save outcomes represented after an accepted in-memory edit without collapsing a dirty publication into full refusal or success?
Which RED, USE and golden-signal fields expose preparation, human gating, edit and persistence outcomes without logging packet, confirmation, credential, locator or document content?

rosetta.intent: publish one exact private Rune-author projection packet into one pre-admitted Vellum document only after separate accountable human confirmation, preserving revision identity, edit uncertainty and durable-save recovery without granting the designing actor mutation authority
outcomes: preview deterministically qualifies and buffers one exact Rune packet, observes one exact current pre-admitted Vellum document and returns a content-free confirmation challenge without mutation

execution repeats qualification and observation, requires an exact accountable human confirmation over the packet, target and durable operation identities, and refuses stale or substituted evidence before mutation
one accepted Vellum owner edit replaces the complete target at its exact revision and no edit is retried when delivery is unknown

an accepted edit is durably saved once under a caller-persisted operation identity, while refused or unknown persistence remains explicitly pending and recoverable through Vellum's existing lookup contract
no path grants workspace membership, arbitrary document selection, shell, approval inference, task mutation, artifact materialization, go-no-go or rollout authority
rosetta.who: the accountable human reviewer, Pantheon's bounded Rune publication adapter, the deployment-owned Rune author and the sovereign Vellum workspace owner
rosetta.what: one two-phase preview-and-publish transaction for a single qualified packet document
rosetta.when: after Rune, Scry, Smith and target verification qualify a private packet and before any downstream artifact materialization or execution
rosetta.where: a deployment-pinned Rune profile and one deployment-pinned, pre-admitted Vellum workspace document
rosetta.why: the designing ensemble must not mutate source after independent verification, while the reviewed lossless packet needs a durable owner-controlled provenance boundary
rosetta.how: recompute the qualified packet, observe and digest the exact Vellum target, prepare an exact whole-document replacement, bind a human confirmation to every identity, submit once, then perform or recover one separately identified durable save
rosetta.extent: one packet and one existing Vellum document; no multi-document durable atomicity claim, packet-to-artifact extraction, membership change, agent-facing tool admission or operating-system sandbox claim
examples: preview binds packet P to workspace W document D revision R and durable operation O; the human confirms that exact challenge and execution publishes P then returns a durable receipt
the target advances after preview, so execution refuses stale evidence before sending an edit
the edit is accepted but durable delivery becomes unknown, so the result remains persistence-pending with O and the existing exact Vellum lookup next action
